_doc: PRIOR ART: none hold these as one table. Each row is one committed k-of-n count from an experiment write-up or result file (file + quote), curated for the OCR failure-rate model (#6740). Subsets of a row (per-script splits, single books inside a batch) are left out so no page is counted twice. Built by hand from a provenance-tagged extraction; the Pareto charts' own failed reads come from ocr-table.jsonl.
